financialOnboarding.title: Configure accounting currency and internal credits
financialOnboarding.description: Choose how Conduit API records prices and costs, and how balances are presented to users.
financialOnboarding.lockNote: Your accounting currency is locked after pricing data is created. Credit naming and conversion can still be adjusted in system settings.
financialOnboarding.currencyHelp: The real currency used for prices, costs, and financial reporting.
financialOnboarding.currencyError: Select a supported three-letter ISO currency.
financialOnboarding.creditNameHelp: The name users see alongside their available balance.
financialOnboarding.creditNameError: Enter a display name for internal credits.
financialOnboarding.creditsPerUnitHelp: Enter the positive decimal amount represented by one unit of your accounting currency.
financialOnboarding.loadErrorTitle: Financial settings could not be loaded
financialOnboarding.loadErrorDescription: Check the server connection and retry. No settings have been changed.
financialOnboarding.saveError: Your financial setup was not marked complete. Review the connection and retry; the values shown here remain editable.
financialOnboarding.statusError: Setup status could not be verified
financialOnboarding.statusErrorDescripti: For safety, the console will remain here until the server confirms your onboarding status.
